_doc: Grixis decks published with legality_status: pending (Bot cycle 38). Each entry lists the cards that are not yet Commander-legal and the official date the cards become Commander-legal (Bot cycle 44: Wizards' announcement, `legal_from_source`; earlier the Scryfall set release date). scripts/activate_pending_grixis.py refreshes the Scryfall bulk, re-checks these cards and sets status to active once every listed card is Commander-legal; validate_all fails a pending deck once legal_from has passed or its cards are already legal.

The_Madcap_Jester.note: The commander and Dragon's Smile come from Scryfall set `mbc` (draft_innovation). Both are `not_legal` in Commander (Scryfall API and bulk, checked 2026-10-16) until Wizards' Commander-legal date, 2026-11-13. The source's 2026-10-15 approval keeps them under its registered *future-release* exceptions. Bot cycle 44: `legal_from` set to Wizards' official Commander date, 2026-11-13 (earlier it used Scryfall's set release date): "New-to-Magic MBC cards will be legal in Commander on November 13, 2026."
